PIVOTAL RESULT — 70% AAER reduction vs placebo across all endotypes, including low-eos patients (<150 cells/μL). Treatment policy estimand critical: exacerbations counted even when patients changed ICS doses mid-trial. Sets the benchmark all TSLP-targeting assets must clear. Ongoing COPD Ph3 (SUNRISE).
H1 2026 — Positive COPD Ph3 data (ex-smokers, eos≥150)

POSITIVE — ~25% AECOPD reduction vs placebo in ex-smokers (eos ≥150 cells/μL). First anti-IL-33 biologic approved in COPD. Narrower label than tezepelumab (ex-smokers only; eos threshold required). Opens the alarmin-targeting COPD biologic market and directly motivates TSLP×IL-33 bispecific development.

Primary completion Mar 2026; topline H2 2026. Anti-ST2/IL-33R. Positive RESCUE-COPD Ph2 signals supported Ph3 advancement. Unique HF (heart failure) angle — no other respiratory biologic targets cardiovascular comorbidity. If positive, AZ will have two approved COPD alarmin agents (tozorakimab + astegolimab).

Anti-ST2/IL-33R in Ph3 severe asthma. Roche also holds QX031N (TSLP×IL-33 bispecific via Qyuns deal) — two complementary IL-33 pathway approaches. PACIFIC result will show whether IL-33R blockade alone can replicate tezepelumab's 70% exacerbation reduction, or whether dual TSLP+IL-33 blockade is needed.

Long-acting anti-TSLP monoAb licensed to Aclaris ($40M upfront, >$900M total, Nov 2024). H2 2026 Ph2a asthma efficacy readout. First data for a SC long-acting anti-TSLP vs. tezepelumab standard dosing (210mg Q4W). Results proxy whether extended half-life format is clinically competitive.

Ph2 asthma exacerbation primary endpoint (treatment policy estimand expected). Licensed to Windward Bio ($45M upfront, $970M total). First China-origin anti-TSLP monoAb in Ph2 efficacy readout. H2 2026 data will validate (or challenge) the quality of Chinese TSLP monoAbs vs. approved tezepelumab.

TSLP×IL-13 bispecific licensed to Windward Bio ($700M total, Dec 2025). Unique format: upstream TSLP blockade combined with downstream IL-13 — the key effector cytokine in asthma and atopic dermatitis. H1 2027 Ph1 safety/PK completion. Windward now holds both HBM9378 (anti-TSLP mono) and WIN027 (TSLP bispecific).

TSLP×IL-33 bispecific licensed to Roche ($75M upfront, $1.07B total, Oct 2025). Roche also has astegolimab (anti-ST2/IL-33R) in Ph3 — QX031N adds dual upstream TSLP+IL-33 blockade. ~2027 FIH data. Most strategically important single asset in the TSLP bispecific space; clean Ph1 enables Roche pivotal planning.

IL-4Rα×TSLP bispecific combining dupilumab's mechanism (IL-4/13 blockade via IL-4Rα) with upstream TSLP suppression. Could compete directly with dupilumab in asthma and AD while adding TSLP breadth. Innovent actively seeking global partner; Ph1 data in 2026–2027 will be the licensing catalyst.

TSLP×IL-11 bispecific — the IL-11 arm is uniquely fibrotic, targeting tissue remodeling in IPF (idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis). Only TSLP-targeting asset in IPF. Ph1 primary completion Jun 2025; efficacy readout 2026–2027. Creates a non-respiratory BD angle (fibrosis) that differentiates from all other TSLP programs.
